2013-12-28 minus 29 weeks = 2013-06-15 (since 29 weeks = 203 days, 28 weeks = 196 days, so 29 weeks = 196 + 7 = 203 days).  
203 days minus 5 more days = 198 days before 2013-12-28.  
198 days before 2013-12-28:  
From 2013-12-28 back 28 days → 2013-11-30.  
Remaining 170 days: back to 2013-06-12? Let’s compute directly:  
Days in June 2013 after 15th = 15 days (June 16–30).  
July: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec up to 28th: 28 days.  
Sum = 15+31+31+30+31+30+28 = 196 days from 2013-06-15 to 2013-12-28.  
We need 198 days before, so 2 days earlier than 2013-06-15 → 2013-06-13.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2013-06-13
